chunks: Then come to the Black Stone and touch it. If you are not able, then wipe it with your hand and kiss your hand. If you are not able, then face it, point toward it with your hand, kiss it, say takbir, and say the like of what you said on the day you circumambulated the House, on the day you arrived in Makkah. Circumambulate the House seven circuits as was described to you. Then pray two rak'ahs at Maqam Ibrahim عليه السلام, reciting in them in the first: al-Hamd and Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad; and in the second: al-Hamd and Qul Ya Ayyuha al-Kafirun. Then return to the Black Stone and kiss it if you are able, or touch it, and say takbir.

key_terms.الْحَجَرَ الْأَسْوَدَ: the Black Stone of the Ka'bah approached and touched in tawaf rites
key_terms.الْحَمْدَ: Surah al-Fatihah, recited in the prayer
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيْنِ: the two units of prayer performed after tawaf
key_terms.فَتَسْتَلِمُهُ: to touch or make ritual contact with it
key_terms.مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: the Station of Ibrahim عليه السلام near which the prayer is offered
key_terms.وَطُفْ: perform tawaf, circling the Ka'bah ritually

ai.seo_question: How should one perform istلام of the Black Stone and the prayer after tawaf in hajj?
ai.summary: This passage outlines part of the ritual procedure of hajj related to the Black Stone, tawaf, and the two rak'ahs at Maqam Ibrahim عليه السلام. It gives practical rulings for direct contact, gesturing when unable, prescribed recitations in prayer, and returning to the Black Stone afterward.
